## BILLBOARD_WGSL
const BILLBOARD_WGSL = "\n\nstruct EngineGlobals {\n  logicalSize: vec2f,\n  targetSize: vec2f,\n  time: f32,\n  dt: f32,\n  _pad: vec2f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> globals: EngineGlobals;\nstruct EngineCamera {\n  view: mat4x4f,\n  proj: mat4x4f,\n  view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  camera_pos: vec4f,\n  viewport: vec4f,\n  view_index: u32,\n  _pad0: u32, _pad1: u32, _pad2: u32,\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view: mat4x4f,\n  jitter: vec4f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> camera: EngineCamera;\n\nstruct Billboard {\n  pos: vec4f,\n  size: vec4f,\n  uv: vec4f,\n  color: vec4f,\n  color2: vec4f,\n};\n@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> billboards: array<Billboard>;\n@group(1) @binding(1) var atlas_sampler: sampler;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var atlas: texture_2d<f32>;\n\nstruct VSOut {\n  @builtin(position) clip: vec4f,\n  @location(0) uv: vec2f,\n  @location(1) q: vec2f,\n  @location(2) color: vec4f,\n  @location(3) color2: vec4f,\n  @location(4) @interpolate(flat) flags: u32,\n  @location(5) fraction: f32,\n};\nstruct FragOut {\n  @location(0) color: vec4f,\n  @location(1) emissive: vec4f,\n};\n\nfn view_row(r: u32) -> vec3f {\n  return vec3f(camera.view[0][r], camera.view[1][r], camera.view[2][r]);\n}\n\n@vertex fn vs(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32, @builtin(instance_index) ii: u32) -> VSOut {\n  var o: VSOut;\n  let b = billboards[ii];\n  var corners = array<vec2f, 6>(\n    vec2f(-1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, 1.0),\n    vec2f(-1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, 1.0), vec2f(-1.0, 1.0)\n  );\n  let q = corners[vi];\n  let flags = u32(b.pos.w + 0.5);\n  let half = b.size.xy * 0.5;\n  if ((flags & 1u) != 0u) {\n    var clip = camera.view_proj * vec4f(b.pos.xyz, 1.0);\n    // Logical px \u2192 target px \u2192 NDC, scaled by w so the division leaves the px size intact.\n    let px_per_logical = globals.targetSize / globals.logicalSize;\n    let ndc = (q * half * px_per_logical) / max(camera.viewport.zw, vec2f(1.0)) * 2.0;\n    clip = vec4f(clip.xy + ndc * clip.w, clip.zw);\n    o.clip = clip;\n  } else {\n    var right = view_row(0u);\n    var up = view_row(1u);\n    if ((flags & 2u) != 0u) {\n      let flat = vec3f(right.x, 0.0, right.z);\n      let len = length(flat);\n      right = select(vec3f(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), flat / max(len, 1e-6), len > 1e-6);\n      up = vec3f(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);\n    }\n    let world = b.pos.xyz + right * (q.x * half.x) + up * (q.y * half.y);\n    o.clip = camera.view_proj * vec4f(world, 1.0);\n  }\n  // Canvas uv: v grows downward, so the top of the quad (q.y = 1) samples v0.\n  let t = q * 0.5 + 0.5;\n  o.uv = vec2f(mix(b.uv.x, b.uv.z, t.x), mix(b.uv.w, b.uv.y, t.y));\n  o.q = t;\n  o.color = b.color;\n  o.color2 = b.color2;\n  o.flags = flags;\n  o.fraction = b.size.z;\n  return o;\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs(in: VSOut) -> FragOut {\n  var c = in.color;\n  if ((in.flags & 8u) != 0u) {\n    c = select(in.color2, in.color, in.q.x < in.fraction);\n  }\n  // Sampled unconditionally: textureSample needs uniform control flow.\n  let s = textureSample(atlas, atlas_sampler, in.uv);\n  c *= select(vec4f(1.0), s, (in.flags & 4u) != 0u);\n  var o: FragOut;\n  o.color = c;\n  o.emissive = vec4f(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, c.a);\n  return o;\n}\n";

## DECAL_CORE_BOX_WGSL
const DECAL_CORE_BOX_WGSL = "\n\nstruct CoreView {\n  viewProj: mat4x4f,\n  position: vec4f,\n  planes: array<vec4f, 6>,\n  index: u32,\n  _a: u32,\n  _b: u32,\n  _c: u32,\n  origin: vec4f,\n  _pad: array<vec4f, 3>,\n};\n\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> view: CoreView;\n\n\nstruct CoreViewExtra {\n  invViewProj: mat4x4f,\n  right: vec4f,\n  up: vec4f,\n  forward: vec4f,\n  _pad: vec4f,\n};\n\nstruct DecalParams {\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f, // unused on the core (the view's extras carry it)\n  // normal_bias, fade_edge, offset, multiply (1 = multiply blend)\n  shape: vec4f,\n  // fade at age 0, fade at age 1, pad, pad\n  fade: vec4f,\n};\n@group(1) @binding(0) var<uniform> decal: DecalParams;\n@group(1) @binding(1) var decal_sampler: sampler;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var decal_tex: texture_2d<f32>;\n@group(1) @binding(3) var scene_depth: texture_depth_2d;\n@group(1) @binding(4) var<storage, read> extras: array<CoreViewExtra>;\n\nstruct DecalVertex {\n  @location(0) position: vec3f,\n  @location(3) m0: vec4f,\n  @location(4) m1: vec4f,\n  @location(5) m2: vec4f,\n  @location(6) uv_rect: vec4f,\n  @location(7) color: vec4f,\n  @location(8) life: vec4f,\n};\n\nstruct DecalFrame {\n  origin: vec3f,\n  ax: vec3f,\n  ay: vec3f,\n  az: vec3f,\n  normal: vec3f,\n};\n\nfn decal_frame(m0: vec4f, m1: vec4f, m2: vec4f) -> DecalFrame {\n  var f: DecalFrame;\n  let s0 = 1.0 / max(dot(m0.xyz, m0.xyz), 1e-12);\n  let s1 = 1.0 / max(dot(m1.xyz, m1.xyz), 1e-12);\n  let s2 = 1.0 / max(dot(m2.xyz, m2.xyz), 1e-12);\n  f.ax = m0.xyz * s0;\n  f.ay = m1.xyz * s1;\n  f.az = m2.xyz * s2;\n  f.origin = -(f.ax * m0.w + f.ay * m1.w + f.az * m2.w);\n  f.normal = normalize(m2.xyz);\n  return f;\n}\n\nfn decal_out(c: vec4f, alpha: f32) -> vec4f {\n  if (decal.shape.w > 0.5) {\n    return vec4f(mix(vec3f(1.0), c.rgb, alpha), 1.0);\n  }\n  return vec4f(c.rgb, alpha);\n}\n\nfn decal_age_fade(life: vec4f) -> f32 {\n  return mix(decal.fade.x, decal.fade.y, clamp(life.x, 0.0, 1.0));\n}\n\nstruct BoxOut {\n  @builtin(position) clip: vec4f,\n  @location(0) ndc: vec4f,\n  @location(1) @interpolate(flat) m0: vec4f,\n  @location(2) @interpolate(flat) m1: vec4f,\n  @location(3) @interpolate(flat) m2: vec4f,\n  @location(4) @interpolate(flat) uv_rect: vec4f,\n  @location(5) @interpolate(flat) color: vec4f,\n  @location(6) @interpolate(flat) life: vec4f,\n  @location(7) @interpolate(flat) normal: vec3f,\n};\n\n@vertex fn vs(v: DecalVertex) -> BoxOut {\n  let f = decal_frame(v.m0, v.m1, v.m2);\n  let world = f.origin + f.ax * v.position.x + f.ay * v.position.y + f.az * v.position.z;\n  var o: BoxOut;\n  o.clip = view.viewProj * vec4f(world - view.origin.xyz, 1.0);\n  o.ndc = o.clip;\n  o.m0 = v.m0;\n  o.m1 = v.m1;\n  o.m2 = v.m2;\n  o.uv_rect = v.uv_rect;\n  o.color = v.color;\n  o.life = v.life;\n  o.normal = f.normal;\n  return o;\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs(in: BoxOut) -> @location(0) vec4f {\n  let dims = vec2i(textureDimensions(scene_depth));\n  let px = clamp(vec2i(in.clip.xy), vec2i(0), dims - vec2i(1));\n  let d = textureLoad(scene_depth, px, 0);\n  if (d >= 1.0) { discard; }\n  // The fragment's own NDC: this eye's viewport, whichever half of the target it covers.\n  let ndc = in.ndc.xy / in.ndc.w;\n  let h = extras[view.index].invViewProj * vec4f(ndc, d, 1.0);\n  let rel = h.xyz / h.w;\n  let w4 = vec4f(rel + view.origin.xyz, 1.0);\n  let local = vec3f(dot(in.m0, w4), dot(in.m1, w4), dot(in.m2, w4));\n  if (any(abs(local) > vec3f(0.5))) { discard; }\n  // Surface normal from the reconstructed position, turned towards the eye.\n  let n0 = normalize(cross(dpdx(rel), dpdy(rel)));\n  let n = select(-n0, n0, dot(n0, view.position.xyz - rel) >= 0.0);\n  if (dot(n, in.normal) < decal.shape.x) { discard; }\n  let uv = in.uv_rect.xy + vec2f(local.x + 0.5, 0.5 - local.y) * in.uv_rect.zw;\n  let c = textureSample(decal_tex, decal_sampler, uv) * in.color;\n  let edge = smoothstep(0.0, max(decal.shape.y, 1e-4), (0.5 - abs(local.z)) * 2.0);\n  return decal_out(c, c.a * edge * decal_age_fade(in.life));\n}\n";

array<vec4f, 3>,\n};\n\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> view: CoreView;\n\n\nstruct CoreViewExtra {\n  invViewProj: mat4x4f,\n  right: vec4f,\n  up: vec4f,\n  forward: vec4f,\n  _pad: vec4f,\n};\n\nstruct DecalParams {\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f, // unused on the core (the view's extras carry it)\n  // normal_bias, fade_edge, offset, multiply (1 = multiply blend)\n  shape: vec4f,\n  // fade at age 0, fade at age 1, pad, pad\n  fade: vec4f,\n};\n@group(1) @binding(0) var<uniform> decal: DecalParams;\n@group(1) @binding(1) var decal_sampler: sampler;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var decal_tex: texture_2d<f32>;\n@group(1) @binding(3) var scene_depth: texture_depth_2d;\n@group(1) @binding(4) var<storage, read> extras: array<CoreViewExtra>;\n\nstruct DecalVertex {\n  @location(0) position: vec3f,\n  @location(3) m0: vec4f,\n  @location(4) m1: vec4f,\n  @location(5) m2: vec4f,\n  @location(6) uv_rect: vec4f,\n  @location(7) color: vec4f,\n  @location(8) life: vec4f,\n};\n\nstruct DecalFrame {\n  origin: vec3f,\n  ax: vec3f,\n  ay: vec3f,\n  az: vec3f,\n  normal: vec3f,\n};\n\nfn decal_frame(m0: vec4f, m1: vec4f, m2: vec4f) -> DecalFrame {\n  var f: DecalFrame;\n  let s0 = 1.0 / max(dot(m0.xyz, m0.xyz), 1e-12);\n  let s1 = 1.0 / max(dot(m1.xyz, m1.xyz), 1e-12);\n  let s2 = 1.0 / max(dot(m2.xyz, m2.xyz), 1e-12);\n  f.ax = m0.xyz * s0;\n  f.ay = m1.xyz * s1;\n  f.az = m2.xyz * s2;\n  f.origin = -(f.ax * m0.w + f.ay * m1.w + f.az * m2.w);\n  f.normal = normalize(m2.xyz);\n  return f;\n}\n\nfn decal_out(c: vec4f, alpha: f32) -> vec4f {\n  if (decal.shape.w > 0.5) {\n    return vec4f(mix(vec3f(1.0), c.rgb, alpha), 1.0);\n  }\n  return vec4f(c.rgb, alpha);\n}\n\nfn decal_age_fade(life: vec4f) -> f32 {\n  return mix(decal.fade.x, decal.fade.y, clamp(life.x, 0.0, 1.0));\n}\n\nstruct QuadOut {\n  @builtin(position) clip: vec4f,\n  @location(0) uv: vec2f,\n  @location(1) @interpolate(flat) color: vec4f,\n  @location(2) @interpolate(flat) life: vec4f,\n};\n\n@vertex fn vs(v: DecalVertex) -> QuadOut {\n  let f = decal_frame(v.m0, v.m1, v.m2);\n  let world = f.origin + f.ax * v.position.x + f.ay * v.position.y + f.normal * decal.shape.z;\n  var o: QuadOut;\n  o.clip = view.viewProj * vec4f(world - view.origin.xyz, 1.0);\n  o.uv = v.uv_rect.xy + vec2f(v.position.x + 0.5, 0.5 - v.position.y) * v.uv_rect.zw;\n  o.color = v.color;\n  o.life = v.life;\n  return o;\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs(in: QuadOut) -> @location(0) vec4f {\n  let c = textureSample(decal_tex, decal_sampler, in.uv) * in.color;\n  return decal_out(c, c.a * decal_age_fade(in.life));\n}\n";

    blend?: DecalBlend;
    fade?: [number, number];
    lifetime?: number;
    mode?: DecalMode;
    offset?: number;
    normalBias?: number;
    fadeEdge?: number;
    readsDepth?: boolean;
    random?: Random;
}

## Effect
class Effect {
    readonly systems: ParticleSystem[];
    readonly instances: EffectInstance[];
    readonly duration: number;
    readonly loop: boolean;
    readonly random: Random;
    constructor(renderer: Renderer, desc: EffectDesc, textures?: Record<string, TextureLike>, random?: Random);
    play(at?: EffectPoint): EffectInstance;
    attach(getPosition: EffectFollow): EffectInstance;
    stop(): void;
    update(dt: number): void;
    draw(frame: Frame, order?: number): void;
    destroy(): void;
}

}

        params: EmitParams;

    };

}

## PARTICLE_COMPUTE_WGSL
const PARTICLE_COMPUTE_WGSL = "\n\nstruct Particle {\n  posVel: vec4f,  // pos.xy, vel.xy (logical px, px/s)\n  c0: vec4f,      // colour at birth (linear, premultiplied by nothing)\n  c1: vec4f,      // colour at death\n  life: vec4f,    // age, lifetime, size at birth, size at death\n  phys: vec4f,    // gravity.xy, drag, emissive\n};\nstruct Sim {\n  dt: f32,\n  floorY: f32,\n  bounce: f32,\n  time: f32,\n  capacity: f32,\n  stretch: f32,\n  spawnCount: f32,\n  _pad: f32,\n};\n\nstruct Spawn {\n  a: vec4f,   // x, y, shapeA, shapeB\n  b: vec4f,   // angle, spread, speedMin, speedMax\n  c: vec4f,   // lifeMin, lifeMax, sizeStart, sizeEnd\n  c0: vec4f,\n  c1: vec4f,\n  d: vec4f,   // gravX, gravY, drag, shapeKind (0 point, 1 circle, 2 rect, 3 line)\n  e: vec4f,   // start, count, seed, emissive\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<storage, read_write> particles: array<Particle>;\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> spawns: array<Spawn>;\n@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> sim: Sim;\n\nfn pcg(v: u32) -> u32 {\n  let s = v * 747796405u + 2891336453u;\n  let w = ((s >> ((s >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ s) * 277803737u;\n  return (w >> 22u) ^ w;\n}\nfn rnd(state: ptr<function, u32>) -> f32 {\n  *state = pcg(*state);\n  return f32(*state) / 4294967295.0;\n}\n\n@compute @workgroup_size(64) fn spawn(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3u) {\n  if (f32(gid.y) >= sim.spawnCount) { return; }\n  let cmd = spawns[gid.y];\n  let i = gid.x;\n  if (f32(i) >= cmd.e.y) { return; }\n  let cap = u32(sim.capacity);\n  let idx = (u32(cmd.e.x) + i) % cap;\n  var st = pcg(i ^ pcg(u32(cmd.e.z)));\n\n  var pos = cmd.a.xy;\n  let kind = cmd.d.w;\n  if (kind > 0.5 && kind < 1.5) {\n    let r = sqrt(rnd(&st)) * cmd.a.z;\n    let th = rnd(&st) * 6.2831853;\n    pos += vec2f(cos(th), sin(th)) * r;\n  } else if (kind > 1.5 && kind < 2.5) {\n    pos += (vec2f(rnd(&st), rnd(&st)) - 0.5) * cmd.a.zw;\n  } else if (kind > 2.5) {\n    pos += cmd.a.zw * rnd(&st);\n  }\n  let ang = cmd.b.x + (rnd(&st) - 0.5) * cmd.b.y;\n  let speed = mix(cmd.b.z, cmd.b.w, rnd(&st));\n  let life = mix(cmd.c.x, cmd.c.y, rnd(&st));\n  let sj = 0.7 + 0.6 * rnd(&st);\n\n  var p: Particle;\n  p.posVel = vec4f(pos, vec2f(cos(ang), sin(ang)) * speed);\n  p.c0 = cmd.c0;\n  p.c1 = cmd.c1;\n  p.life = vec4f(0.0, max(life, 1e-3), cmd.c.z * sj, cmd.c.w * sj);\n  p.phys = vec4f(cmd.d.xyz, cmd.e.w);\n  particles[idx] = p;\n}\n\n@compute @workgroup_size(64) fn update(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3u) {\n  let i = gid.x;\n  if (f32(i) >= sim.capacity) { return; }\n  var p = particles[i];\n  if (p.life.x >= p.life.y) { return; }\n  let dt = sim.dt;\n  p.life.x += dt;\n  var v = p.posVel.zw + p.phys.xy * dt;\n  v *= exp(-p.phys.z * dt);\n  var pos = p.posVel.xy + v * dt;\n  if (pos.y > sim.floorY && v.y > 0.0) {\n    pos.y = sim.floorY;\n    v = vec2f(v.x * 0.75, -v.y * sim.bounce);\n  }\n  p.posVel = vec4f(pos, v);\n  particles[i] = p;\n}\n";

## PARTICLE_CORE_RENDER_WGSL
const PARTICLE_CORE_RENDER_WGSL: string;

## PARTICLE_COUNT_WGSL
const PARTICLE_COUNT_WGSL = "\nstruct CountParams {\n  capacity: u32,\n  stride: u32,\n  lifeAt: u32,\n  posAt: u32,\n  belowY: f32,\n  _a: f32,\n  _b: f32,\n  _c: f32,\n};\nstruct Counts {\n  alive: atomic<u32>,\n  below: atomic<u32>,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<storage, read> data: array<vec4f>;\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read_write> counts: Counts;\n@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> params: CountParams;\n@compute @workgroup_size(64) fn count(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3u) {\n  if (gid.x >= params.capacity) { return; }\n  let life = data[gid.x * params.stride + params.lifeAt];\n  if (life.x < life.y) {\n    atomicAdd(&counts.alive, 1u);\n    if (data[gid.x * params.stride + params.posAt].y < params.belowY) {\n      atomicAdd(&counts.below, 1u);\n    }\n  }\n}\n";

## PARTICLE_EXT_RENDER_WGSL

## PARTICLE_RENDER_WGSL
const PARTICLE_RENDER_WGSL = "\n\nstruct EngineGlobals {\n  logicalSize: vec2f,\n  targetSize: vec2f,\n  time: f32,\n  dt: f32,\n  _pad: vec2f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> globals: EngineGlobals;\nstruct EngineCamera {\n  view: mat4x4f,\n  proj: mat4x4f,\n  view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  camera_pos: vec4f,\n  viewport: vec4f,\n  view_index: u32,\n  _pad0: u32, _pad1: u32, _pad2: u32,\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view: mat4x4f,\n  jitter: vec4f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> camera: EngineCamera;\n\n\nstruct Particle {\n  posVel: vec4f,  // pos.xy, vel.xy (logical px, px/s)\n  c0: vec4f,      // colour at birth (linear, premultiplied by nothing)\n  c1: vec4f,      // colour at death\n  life: vec4f,    // age, lifetime, size at birth, size at death\n  phys: vec4f,    // gravity.xy, drag, emissive\n};\nstruct Sim {\n  dt: f32,\n  floorY: f32,\n  bounce: f32,\n  time: f32,\n  capacity: f32,\n  stretch: f32,\n  spawnCount: f32,\n  _pad: f32,\n};\n\n@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> particles: array<Particle>;\n@group(1) @binding(1) var<uniform> sim: Sim;\n\nstruct PVOut {\n  @builtin(position) clip: vec4f,\n  @location(0) q: vec2f,\n  @location(1) color: vec4f,\n  @location(2) emissive: f32,\n};\nstruct FragOut {\n  @location(0) color: vec4f,\n  @location(1) emissive: vec4f,\n};\n\n@vertex fn vs(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32, @builtin(instance_index) ii: u32) -> PVOut {\n  var o: PVOut;\n  let p = particles[ii];\n  if (p.life.x >= p.life.y) {\n    o.clip = vec4f(0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 1.0);\n    return o;\n  }\n  var corners = array<vec2f, 6>(\n    vec2f(-1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, 1.0),\n    vec2f(-1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, 1.0), vec2f(-1.0, 1.0)\n  );\n  let q = corners[vi];\n  let t = p.life.x / p.life.y;\n  let size = max(mix(p.life.z, p.life.w, t), 0.0);\n  let vel = p.posVel.zw;\n  let speed = length(vel);\n  var dir = vec2f(1.0, 0.0);\n  if (speed > 1e-3) { dir = vel / speed; }\n  let len = size + speed * sim.stretch;\n  let perp = vec2f(-dir.y, dir.x);\n  let world = p.posVel.xy + dir * (q.x * len * 0.5) + perp * (q.y * size * 0.5);\n  o.clip = camera.view_proj * vec4f(world, 0.0, 1.0);\n  o.q = q;\n  o.color = mix(p.c0, p.c1, t);\n  o.emissive = p.phys.w;\n  return o;\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs(in: PVOut) -> FragOut {\n  let d = length(in.q);\n  var a = clamp(1.0 - d, 0.0, 1.0);\n  a = a * a * in.color.a;\n  let c = in.color.rgb * a;\n  var o: FragOut;\n  o.color = vec4f(c, a);\n  o.emissive = vec4f(c * in.emissive, a);\n  return o;\n}\n";

## TRAIL_TEXTURED_WGSL
const TRAIL_TEXTURED_WGSL = "\n@group(1) @binding(1) var trailSampler: sampler;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var trailTex: texture_2d<f32>;\n\nfn trail_edge(local_v: f32, softness: f32) -> f32 {\n  let edge = abs(local_v - 0.5) * 2.0;\n  return 1.0 - smoothstep(1.0 - max(softness, 1e-4), 1.0, edge);\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs_main(in: VSOut) -> FragOut {\n  let t = textureSample(trailTex, trailSampler, in.uv);\n  let rgb = in.color.rgb * t.rgb;\n  let a = in.color.a * t.a * trail_edge(in.local.y, in.params.x);\n  var o: FragOut;\n  o.color = vec4f(rgb, a);\n  o.emissive = vec4f(rgb * in.emissive, a);\n  return o;\n}\n";

## TRAIL_WGSL
const TRAIL_WGSL = "\nfn trail_edge(local_v: f32, softness: f32) -> f32 {\n  let edge = abs(local_v - 0.5) * 2.0;\n  return 1.0 - smoothstep(1.0 - max(softness, 1e-4), 1.0, edge);\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs_main(in: VSOut) -> FragOut {\n  let a = in.color.a * trail_edge(in.local.y, in.params.x);\n  var o: FragOut;\n  o.color = vec4f(in.color.rgb, a);\n  o.emissive = vec4f(in.color.rgb * in.emissive, a);\n  return o;\n}\n";

## TrailOptions  (type-only)
interface TrailOptions {
    space?: '2d' | 'world';

    width?: number;
    widthCurve?: ArrayLike<number>;

    texture?: TextureLike;
    uvMode?: 'stretch' | 'tile';
    softness?: number;
    label?: string;
}

## WATER_CORE_FLOATS
const WATER_CORE_FLOATS = 16;

## WATER_CORE_WGSL
const WATER_CORE_WGSL = "\n\nstruct CoreView {\n  viewProj: mat4x4f,\n  position: vec4f,\n  planes: array<vec4f, 6>,\n  index: u32,\n  _a: u32,\n  _b: u32,\n  _c: u32,\n  origin: vec4f,\n  _pad: array<vec4f, 3>,\n};\n\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> view: CoreView;\n\n\nstruct CoreViewExtra {\n  invViewProj: mat4x4f,\n  right: vec4f,\n  up: vec4f,\n  forward: vec4f,\n  _pad: vec4f,\n};\n\nstruct WaterParams {\n  shallow: vec4f,     // rgb, opacity\n  deep: vec4f,        // rgb, depth fade (world units)\n  surface: vec4f,     // fresnel, roughness, displace, level\n  foam: vec4f,        // rgb, width (0 = off)\n  misc: vec4f,        // time, wave count, depth copy on, origin y\n  waves: array<vec4f, 4>, // scale, speed, amplitude, direction angle\n};\n\nstruct WaterCore {\n  sun: vec4f,       // direction to the sun xyz, on\n  sun_color: vec4f, // rgb, unused\n  sky: vec4f,       // horizon rgb, unused\n  opts: vec4f,      // refraction strength (0 off), reflection steps (0 off), reflection reach, unused\n};\n@group(1) @binding(0) var<uniform> water: WaterParams;\n@group(1) @binding(1) var<uniform> wc: WaterCore;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var scene_depth: texture_depth_2d;\n@group(1) @binding(3) var scene_color: texture_2d<f32>;\n@group(1) @binding(4) var<storage, read> extras: array<CoreViewExtra>;\n\nstruct VertexIn {\n  @location(0) pos: vec3f,\n  @location(10) normal: vec3f,\n  @location(1) uv: vec2f,\n  @location(2) color: vec4f,\n};\n\nstruct WaterOut {\n  @builtin(position) clip: vec4f,\n  @location(0) world: vec3f,\n  @location(1) ndc: vec4f,\n};\n\n\nfn engine_hash21(p: vec2f) -> f32 {\n  var p3 = fract(vec3f(p.x, p.y, p.x) * 0.1031);\n  p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);\n  return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);\n}\nfn engine_hash22(p: vec2f) -> vec2f {\n  var p3 = fract(vec3f(p.x, p.y, p.x) * vec3f(0.1031, 0.1030, 0.0973));\n  p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);\n  return fract((p3.xx + p3.yz) * p3.zy);\n}\nfn engine_noise(p: vec2f) -> f32 {\n  let i = floor(p);\n  let f = fract(p);\n  let u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);\n  let a = engine_hash21(i);\n  let b = engine_hash21(i + vec2f(1.0, 0.0));\n  let c = engine_hash21(i + vec2f(0.0, 1.0));\n  let d = engine_hash21(i + vec2f(1.0, 1.0));\n  return mix(mix(a, b, u.x), mix(c, d, u.x), u.y);\n}\nfn engine_fbm(p: vec2f, octaves: i32) -> f32 {\n  var v = 0.0;\n  var amp = 0.5;\n  var q = p;\n  for (var i = 0; i < octaves; i++) {\n    v += amp * engine_noise(q);\n    q = q * 2.03 + vec2f(17.1, 9.2);\n    amp *= 0.5;\n  }\n  return v;\n}\nfn engine_luma(c: vec3f) -> f32 {\n  return dot(c, vec3f(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));\n}\n\n// One layer's value and gradient (d/dp.x, d/dp.y) at p.\nfn water_wave(p: vec2f) -> vec3f {\n  let a = p.x + 0.6 * sin(1.3 * p.y);\n  let b = 0.8 * p.y + 0.5 * sin(0.9 * p.x);\n  let sa = sin(a);\n  let ca = cos(a);\n  let sb = sin(b);\n  let cb = cos(b);\n  let dx = ca * cb - sa * sb * 0.45 * cos(0.9 * p.x);\n  let dy = ca * cb * 0.78 * cos(1.3 * p.y) - sa * sb * 0.8;\n  return vec3f(sa * cb, dx, dy);\n}\n\n// Summed layers at world (x, z): height sum (before displace) and the normal slope.\nfn water_field(xz: vec2f, t: f32) -> vec3f {\n  var h = 0.0;\n  var slope = vec2f(0.0);\n  let n = u32(water.misc.y);\n  for (var i = 0u; i < n; i++) {\n    let w = water.waves[i];\n    let dir = vec2f(cos(w.w), sin(w.w));\n    let p = xz * w.x + dir * (t * w.y);\n    let f = water_wave(p);\n    h += w.z * f.x;\n    slope += w.z * w.x * f.yz;\n  }\n  return vec3f(h, slope);\n}\n\n\nconst W_PI: f32 = 3.14159265;\n\nfn w_ggx(n_dot_h: f32, a2: f32) -> f32 {\n  let d = n_dot_h * n_dot_h * (a2 - 1.0) + 1.0;\n  return a2 / (W_PI * d * d + 1e-7);\n}\n\nfn w_schlick(cos_t: f32) -> f32 {\n  return 0.02 + 0.98 * pow(1.0 - cos_t, 5.0);\n}\n\n// The world point (the core's frame) under framebuffer pixel px at depth d, for this view.\nfn w_unproject(ndc: vec2f, d: f32) -> vec3f {\n  let h = extras[view.index].invViewProj * vec4f(ndc, d, 1.0);\n  return h.xyz / h.w;\n}\n\n@vertex fn vs(v: VertexIn) -> WaterOut {\n  let t = water.misc.x;\n  let f = water_field(v.pos.xz, t);\n  let world = vec3f(v.pos.x, water.misc.w + water.surface.w + water.surface.z * f.x, v.pos.z);\n  var o: WaterOut;\n  let rel = world - view.origin.xyz;\n  o.clip = view.viewProj * vec4f(rel, 1.0);\n  o.ndc = o.clip;\n  o.world = world;\n  return o;\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs(in: WaterOut) -> @location(0) vec4f {\n  // This eye's viewport in framebuffer pixels (uniform control flow: derivatives first).\n  let ndc = in.ndc.xy / in.ndc.w;\n  let vp_size = vec2f(2.0 / max(abs(dpdx(ndc.x)), 1e-6), 2.0 / max(abs(dpdy(ndc.y)), 1e-6));\n  let vp_min = in.clip.xy - vec2f(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5) * vp_size;\n\n  let t = water.misc.x;\n  let f = water_field(in.world.xz, t);\n  let n = normalize(vec3f(-f.y, 1.0, -f.z));\n  let rel = in.world - view.origin.xyz;\n  let eye = view.position.xyz;\n  let v = normalize(eye - rel);\n  let n_dot_v = max(dot(n, v), 1e-4);\n  let own = length(rel - eye);\n  let depth_fade = max(water.deep.w, 1e-3);\n\n  let ddims = vec2i(textureDimensions(scene_depth));\n  let has_depth_tex = ddims.x > 1;\n  let cdims = vec2i(textureDimensions(scene_color));\n  let has_color = cdims.x > 1;\n\n  // Water depth along the view ray.\n  var diff = depth_fade;\n  var has_depth = false;\n  if (has_depth_tex) {\n    let px = clamp(vec2i(in.clip.xy), vec2i(0), ddims - 1);\n    let d = textureLoad(scene_depth, px, 0);\n    if (d < 1.0) {\n      diff = max(length(w_unproject(ndc, d) - eye) - own, 0.0);\n      has_depth = true;\n    }\n  }\n  let deep_t = saturate(diff / depth_fade);\n\n  // Refraction: the scene behind, nudged by the waves, tinted with depth.\n  var refraction = mix(water.shallow.rgb, water.deep.rgb, deep_t);\n  var opaque = false;\n  if (has_color && wc.opts.x > 0.0) {\n    var px = vec2i(in.clip.xy + n.xz * wc.opts.x * vp_size.y * 0.05 * saturate(diff));\n    px = clamp(px, vec2i(vp_min), vec2i(vp_min + vp_size) - 1);\n    if (has_depth_tex) {\n      let dn = textureLoad(scene_depth, clamp(px, vec2i(0), ddims - 1), 0);\n      let ndc_n = (vec2f(px) + 0.5 - vp_min) / vp_size * vec2f(2.0, -2.0) + vec2f(-1.0, 1.0);\n      if (length(w_unproject(ndc_n, dn) - eye) < own) { px = vec2i(in.clip.xy); }\n    }\n    let behind = textureLoad(scene_color, clamp(px, vec2i(0), cdims - 1), 0).rgb;\n    refraction = mix(behind * mix(vec3f(1.0), water.shallow.rgb * 2.0, saturate(deep_t * 2.0)), water.deep.rgb, deep_t);\n    opaque = true;\n  }\n\n  // Reflection: the sky gradient, or the scene where a short march meets it.\n  let r = reflect(-v, n);\n  let horizon = wc.sky.rgb;\n  let zenith = horizon * vec3f(0.35, 0.55, 1.0);\n  let to_sun = wc.sun.xyz;\n  let has_sun = wc.sun.w > 0.5;\n  let day = select(1.0, smoothstep(-0.12, 0.08, to_sun.y), has_sun);\n  var refl = mix(horizon, zenith, pow(saturate(r.y), 0.6)) * mix(0.06, 1.0, day);\n  let steps = u32(wc.opts.y);\n  if (has_color && has_depth_tex && steps > 0u) {\n    let reach = max(wc.opts.z, 1e-3);\n    for (var i = 1u; i <= steps; i++) {\n      let p = rel + r * (reach * f32(i) / f32(steps));\n      let c = view.viewProj * vec4f(p, 1.0);\n      if (c.w <= 1e-4) { break; }\n      let q = c.xy / c.w;\n      if (any(abs(q) > vec2f(1.0))) { break; }\n      let fp = vp_min + (q * vec2f(0.5, -0.5) + 0.5) * vp_size;\n      let ip = clamp(vec2i(fp), vec2i(0), ddims - 1);\n      let sd = textureLoad(scene_depth, ip, 0);\n      if (sd < c.z / c.w) {\n        refl = textureLoad(scene_color, clamp(ip, vec2i(0), cdims - 1), 0).rgb;\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  let fresnel = water.surface.x * w_schlick(n_dot_v);\n  var col = mix(refraction, refl, saturate(fresnel));\n\n  // Sun highlight.\n  let n_dot_l = dot(n, to_sun);\n  if (has_sun && n_dot_l > 0.0) {\n    let rough = max(water.surface.y, 0.045);\n    let a2 = rough * rough * rough * rough;\n    let h = normalize(to_sun + v);\n    let k = a2 * 0.5;\n    let vis = 0.25 / ((n_dot_v * (1.0 - k) + k) * (n_dot_l * (1.0 - k) + k));\n    col += wc.sun_color.rgb * w_ggx(saturate(dot(n, h)), a2) * vis * n_dot_l * w_schlick(saturate(dot(v, h)));\n  }\n\n  // Alpha: transparent at the shoreline, opacity further out (opaque with refraction).\n  let far_alpha = select(water.shallow.w, 1.0, opaque);\n  var alpha = far_alpha * smoothstep(0.0, 0.25 * depth_fade, diff);\n  if (!has_depth) { alpha = far_alpha; }\n\n  // Foam against geometry.\n  if (has_depth && water.foam.w > 0.0) {\n    let edge = saturate(1.0 - diff / water.foam.w);\n    let mask = 0.65 * engine_noise(in.world.xz * 5.0 + vec2f(t * 0.4, -t * 0.3))\n      + 0.35 * engine_noise(in.world.xz * 13.0 - vec2f(t * 0.9, t * 0.5));\n    let foam = edge * smoothstep(0.42, 0.72, mask + 0.4 * edge);\n    col = mix(col, water.foam.rgb, foam);\n    alpha = max(alpha, foam * water.shallow.w);\n  }\n  return vec4f(col * alpha, alpha);\n}\n";

## WATER_DEPTH_COPY_WGSL
const WATER_DEPTH_COPY_WGSL = "\n@group(0) @binding(0) var src: texture_depth_2d;\n@vertex fn vs(@builtin(vertex_index) i: u32) -> @builtin(position) vec4f {\n  let p = vec2f(f32((i << 1u) & 2u), f32(i & 2u));\n  return vec4f(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);\n}\n@fragment fn fs(@builtin(position) pos: vec4f) -> @builtin(frag_depth) f32 {\n  return textureLoad(src, vec2i(pos.xy), 0);\n}\n";

## WEATHER_RAIN

## WEATHER_WGSL
const WEATHER_WGSL = "\n\nstruct CoreView {\n  viewProj: mat4x4f,\n  position: vec4f,\n  planes: array<vec4f, 6>,\n  index: u32,\n  _a: u32,\n  _b: u32,\n  _c: u32,\n  origin: vec4f,\n  _pad: array<vec4f, 3>,\n};\n\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> view: CoreView;\n\n\nstruct CoreViewExtra {\n  invViewProj: mat4x4f,\n  right: vec4f,\n  up: vec4f,\n  forward: vec4f,\n  _pad: vec4f,\n};\n\nstruct Layer {\n  a: vec4f,   // first instance, instances, radius, height\n  b: vec4f,   // fall speed, wind factor, length, width\n  c: vec4f,   // rgb, alpha\n  d: vec4f,   // shape (0 streak, 1 flake, 2 dust), flutter, seed, unused\n};\nstruct Weather {\n  anchor: vec4f,  // xyz (the core's frame), time\n  wind: vec4f,    // x, z (units/s), intensity, layer count\n  occl: vec4f,    // flat height, map on, map origin x, map origin z\n  occl2: vec4f,   // map size x, map size z, near fade, light\n  layers: array<Layer, 4>,\n};\n@group(1) @binding(0) var<uniform> w: Weather;\n@group(1) @binding(1) var<storage, read> extras: array<CoreViewExtra>;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var height_map: texture_2d<f32>;\n\nstruct WOut {\n  @builtin(position) clip: vec4f,\n  @location(0) uv: vec2f,\n  @location(1) color: vec4f,\n  @location(2) @interpolate(flat) shape: u32,\n};\n\nfn hash11(p: f32) -> f32 {\n  var x = fract(p * 0.1031);\n  x *= x + 33.33;\n  x *= x + x;\n  return fract(x);\n}\n\n// The occlusion height at xz (the core's frame): the flat height, raised by the map inside it.\nfn occlusion(xz: vec2f) -> f32 {\n  var h = w.occl.x;\n  if (w.occl.y > 0.5) {\n    let uv = (xz - w.occl.zw) / w.occl2.xy;\n    if (all(uv >= vec2f(0.0)) && all(uv < vec2f(1.0))) {\n      let dims = vec2f(textureDimensions(height_map));\n      let px = vec2i(uv * dims);\n      h = max(h, textureLoad(height_map, px, 0).r);\n    }\n  }\n  return h;\n}\n\n@vertex fn vs(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32, @builtin(instance_index) ii: u32) -> WOut {\n  var o: WOut;\n  o.clip = vec4f(0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 1.0);\n  var corners = array<vec2f, 6>(\n    vec2f(-1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, 1.0),\n    vec2f(-1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, 1.0), vec2f(-1.0, 1.0)\n  );\n  let corner = corners[vi];\n  // The layer: the last whose first instance is at or below this one.\n  let n = u32(w.wind.w);\n  var li = 0u;\n  for (var k = 1u; k < n; k++) {\n    if (f32(ii) >= w.layers[k].a.x) { li = k; }\n  }\n  let L = w.layers[li];\n  let local = f32(ii) - L.a.x;\n  if (local >= L.a.y) { return o; }\n  let s = local + 0.5 + L.d.z;\n  let R = L.a.z;\n  let H = L.a.w;\n  let speed = max(L.b.x, 1e-3);\n  let shape = u32(L.d.x + 0.5);\n  let t = w.anchor.w;\n  let wv = w.wind.xy * L.b.y;\n  let fall = t * speed / H + hash11(s * 9.41 + 1.0);\n  let cyc = floor(fall);\n  let ph = fract(fall);\n  // A new column each cycle, so the pattern never repeats; wrapped around the anchor.\n  let start = vec2f(hash11(s * 3.1 + cyc * 7.7), hash11(s * 5.9 + cyc * 3.3)) * 2.0 * R;\n  let anchor = w.anchor.xyz;\n  let rel = start + wv * ph * H / speed - anchor.xz;\n  let wrapped = (fract((rel + R) / (2.0 * R)) * 2.0 - 1.0) * R;\n  var p = vec3f(anchor.x + wrapped.x, anchor.y + H * 0.55 - ph * H, anchor.z + wrapped.y);\n  let ground = occlusion(p.xz);\n  var vel = vec3f(wv.x, -speed, wv.y);\n  if (shape == 2u) {\n    // Dust streams low over the ground, carried by the wind.\n    p.y = max(ground, anchor.y - 3.0) + hash11(s * 2.3 + cyc) * H * 0.7;\n    vel = vec3f(wv.x, -0.15 * speed, wv.y);\n  }\n  if (shape == 1u) {\n    p.x += sin(t * 1.3 + s) * L.d.y;\n    p.z += cos(t * 1.1 + s * 1.7) * L.d.y;\n  }\n  let eye = view.position.xyz;\n  let d = length(p - eye);\n  if (p.y <= ground || d < w.occl2.z) { return o; }\n  let e = extras[view.index];\n  let to_eye = normalize(eye - p);\n  var along = normalize(vel + vec3f(0.0, -1e-4, 0.0));\n  var across = normalize(cross(along, to_eye) + vec3f(1e-4, 0.0, 0.0));\n  if (shape == 1u) {\n    along = e.up.xyz;\n    across = e.right.xyz;\n  }\n  let q = p + along * corner.y * L.b.z * 0.5 + across * corner.x * L.b.w * 0.5;\n  o.clip = view.viewProj * vec4f(q, 1.0);\n  o.uv = corner;\n  let edge = length(p.xz - anchor.xz);\n  let fade = smoothstep(w.occl2.z, w.occl2.z + 1.4, d) * (1.0 - smoothstep(R * 0.7, R, edge));\n  o.color = vec4f(L.c.rgb * w.occl2.w, L.c.a * fade * mix(0.7, 1.0, hash11(s * 1.7)));\n  o.shape = shape;\n  return o;\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs(in: WOut) -> @location(0) vec4f {\n  var r: f32;\n  if (in.shape == 0u) {\n    r = 1.0 - in.uv.x * in.uv.x;\n  } else {\n    r = 1.0 - dot(in.uv, in.uv);\n  }\n  if (r <= 0.0) { discard; }\n  let a = clamp(in.color.a * r, 0.0, 1.0);\n  return vec4f(in.color.rgb * a, a);\n}\n";

## WGSL_DECAL_BOX
const WGSL_DECAL_BOX = "\nstruct EngineGlobals {\n  logicalSize: vec2f,\n  targetSize: vec2f,\n  time: f32,\n  dt: f32,\n  _pad: vec2f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> globals: EngineGlobals;\nstruct EngineCamera {\n  view: mat4x4f,\n  proj: mat4x4f,\n  view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  camera_pos: vec4f,\n  viewport: vec4f,\n  view_index: u32,\n  _pad0: u32, _pad1: u32, _pad2: u32,\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view: mat4x4f,\n  jitter: vec4f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> camera: EngineCamera;\n\nstruct DecalParams {\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  // normal_bias, fade_edge, offset, multiply (1 = multiply blend)\n  shape: vec4f,\n  // fade at age 0, fade at age 1, pad, pad\n  fade: vec4f,\n};\n@group(1) @binding(0) var<uniform> decal: DecalParams;\n@group(1) @binding(1) var decal_sampler: sampler;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var decal_tex: texture_2d<f32>;\n@group(1) @binding(3) var scene_depth: texture_depth_2d;\n\nstruct DecalVertex {\n  @location(0) position: vec3f,\n  @location(3) m0: vec4f,\n  @location(4) m1: vec4f,\n  @location(5) m2: vec4f,\n  @location(6) uv_rect: vec4f,\n  @location(7) color: vec4f,\n  @location(8) life: vec4f,\n};\n\nstruct DecalFrame {\n  origin: vec3f,\n  ax: vec3f,\n  ay: vec3f,\n  az: vec3f,\n  normal: vec3f,\n};\n\n// The rows of the world \u2192 local matrix are axis_i / scale_i and -dot(axis_i, origin) / scale_i:\n// local \u2192 world is origin + sum(axis_i * scale_i * local_i).\nfn decal_frame(m0: vec4f, m1: vec4f, m2: vec4f) -> DecalFrame {\n  var f: DecalFrame;\n  let s0 = 1.0 / max(dot(m0.xyz, m0.xyz), 1e-12);\n  let s1 = 1.0 / max(dot(m1.xyz, m1.xyz), 1e-12);\n  let s2 = 1.0 / max(dot(m2.xyz, m2.xyz), 1e-12);\n  f.ax = m0.xyz * s0;\n  f.ay = m1.xyz * s1;\n  f.az = m2.xyz * s2;\n  f.origin = -(f.ax * m0.w + f.ay * m1.w + f.az * m2.w);\n  f.normal = normalize(m2.xyz);\n  return f;\n}\n\nstruct FragOut {\n  @location(0) color: vec4f,\n  @location(1) emissive: vec4f,\n};\n\nfn decal_out(c: vec4f, alpha: f32) -> FragOut {\n  var o: FragOut;\n  if (decal.shape.w > 0.5) {\n    o.color = vec4f(mix(vec3f(1.0), c.rgb, alpha), 1.0);\n    o.emissive = vec4f(1.0);\n  } else {\n    o.color = vec4f(c.rgb, alpha);\n    o.emissive = vec4f(0.0);\n  }\n  return o;\n}\n\nfn decal_age_fade(life: vec4f) -> f32 {\n  return mix(decal.fade.x, decal.fade.y, clamp(life.x, 0.0, 1.0));\n}\n\nstruct BoxOut {\n  @builtin(position) clip: vec4f,\n  @location(0) @interpolate(flat) m0: vec4f,\n  @location(1) @interpolate(flat) m1: vec4f,\n  @location(2) @interpolate(flat) m2: vec4f,\n  @location(3) @interpolate(flat) uv_rect: vec4f,\n  @location(4) @interpolate(flat) color: vec4f,\n  @location(5) @interpolate(flat) life: vec4f,\n  @location(6) @interpolate(flat) normal: vec3f,\n};\n\n@vertex fn vs(v: DecalVertex) -> BoxOut {\n  let f = decal_frame(v.m0, v.m1, v.m2);\n  let world = f.origin + f.ax * v.position.x + f.ay * v.position.y + f.az * v.position.z;\n  var o: BoxOut;\n  o.clip = camera.view_proj * vec4f(world, 1.0);\n  o.m0 = v.m0;\n  o.m1 = v.m1;\n  o.m2 = v.m2;\n  o.uv_rect = v.uv_rect;\n  o.color = v.color;\n  o.life = v.life;\n  o.normal = f.normal;\n  return o;\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs(in: BoxOut) -> FragOut {\n  let dims = vec2i(textureDimensions(scene_depth));\n  let px = clamp(vec2i(in.clip.xy), vec2i(0), dims - vec2i(1));\n  let d = textureLoad(scene_depth, px, 0);\n  if (d >= 1.0) { discard; }\n  let vp = camera.viewport;\n  let ndc = vec2f(\n    (in.clip.x - vp.x) / vp.z * 2.0 - 1.0,\n    1.0 - (in.clip.y - vp.y) / vp.w * 2.0);\n  let wp = decal.inv_view_proj * vec4f(ndc, d, 1.0);\n  let world = wp.xyz / wp.w;\n  let w4 = vec4f(world, 1.0);\n  let local = vec3f(dot(in.m0, w4), dot(in.m1, w4), dot(in.m2, w4));\n  if (any(abs(local) > vec3f(0.5))) { discard; }\n  // Surface normal from the reconstructed position, turned towards the camera.\n  let n0 = normalize(cross(dpdx(world), dpdy(world)));\n  let n = select(-n0, n0, dot(n0, camera.camera_pos.xyz - world) >= 0.0);\n  if (dot(n, in.normal) < decal.shape.x) { discard; }\n  let uv = in.uv_rect.xy + vec2f(local.x + 0.5, 0.5 - local.y) * in.uv_rect.zw;\n  let c = textureSample(decal_tex, decal_sampler, uv) * in.color;\n  let edge = smoothstep(0.0, max(decal.shape.y, 1e-4), (0.5 - abs(local.z)) * 2.0);\n  return decal_out(c, c.a * edge * decal_age_fade(in.life));\n}\n";

## WGSL_DECAL_DEPTH_COPY
const WGSL_DECAL_DEPTH_COPY = "\n@group(0) @binding(0) var src: texture_depth_2d;\n@vertex fn vs(@builtin(vertex_index) i: u32) -> @builtin(position) vec4f {\n  let p = vec2f(f32((i << 1u) & 2u), f32(i & 2u));\n  return vec4f(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);\n}\n@fragment fn fs(@builtin(position) pos: vec4f) -> @builtin(frag_depth) f32 {\n  return textureLoad(src, vec2i(pos.xy), 0);\n}\n";

## WGSL_DECAL_QUAD
const WGSL_DECAL_QUAD = "\nstruct EngineGlobals {\n  logicalSize: vec2f,\n  targetSize: vec2f,\n  time: f32,\n  dt: f32,\n  _pad: vec2f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> globals: EngineGlobals;\nstruct EngineCamera {\n  view: mat4x4f,\n  proj: mat4x4f,\n  view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  camera_pos: vec4f,\n  viewport: vec4f,\n  view_index: u32,\n  _pad0: u32, _pad1: u32, _pad2: u32,\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view: mat4x4f,\n  jitter: vec4f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> camera: EngineCamera;\n\nstruct DecalParams {\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  // normal_bias, fade_edge, offset, multiply (1 = multiply blend)\n  shape: vec4f,\n  // fade at age 0, fade at age 1, pad, pad\n  fade: vec4f,\n};\n@group(1) @binding(0) var<uniform> decal: DecalParams;\n@group(1) @binding(1) var decal_sampler: sampler;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var decal_tex: texture_2d<f32>;\n@group(1) @binding(3) var scene_depth: texture_depth_2d;\n\nstruct DecalVertex {\n  @location(0) position: vec3f,\n  @location(3) m0: vec4f,\n  @location(4) m1: vec4f,\n  @location(5) m2: vec4f,\n  @location(6) uv_rect: vec4f,\n  @location(7) color: vec4f,\n  @location(8) life: vec4f,\n};\n\nstruct DecalFrame {\n  origin: vec3f,\n  ax: vec3f,\n  ay: vec3f,\n  az: vec3f,\n  normal: vec3f,\n};\n\n// The rows of the world \u2192 local matrix are axis_i / scale_i and -dot(axis_i, origin) / scale_i:\n// local \u2192 world is origin + sum(axis_i * scale_i * local_i).\nfn decal_frame(m0: vec4f, m1: vec4f, m2: vec4f) -> DecalFrame {\n  var f: DecalFrame;\n  let s0 = 1.0 / max(dot(m0.xyz, m0.xyz), 1e-12);\n  let s1 = 1.0 / max(dot(m1.xyz, m1.xyz), 1e-12);\n  let s2 = 1.0 / max(dot(m2.xyz, m2.xyz), 1e-12);\n  f.ax = m0.xyz * s0;\n  f.ay = m1.xyz * s1;\n  f.az = m2.xyz * s2;\n  f.origin = -(f.ax * m0.w + f.ay * m1.w + f.az * m2.w);\n  f.normal = normalize(m2.xyz);\n  return f;\n}\n\nstruct FragOut {\n  @location(0) color: vec4f,\n  @location(1) emissive: vec4f,\n};\n\nfn decal_out(c: vec4f, alpha: f32) -> FragOut {\n  var o: FragOut;\n  if (decal.shape.w > 0.5) {\n    o.color = vec4f(mix(vec3f(1.0), c.rgb, alpha), 1.0);\n    o.emissive = vec4f(1.0);\n  } else {\n    o.color = vec4f(c.rgb, alpha);\n    o.emissive = vec4f(0.0);\n  }\n  return o;\n}\n\nfn decal_age_fade(life: vec4f) -> f32 {\n  return mix(decal.fade.x, decal.fade.y, clamp(life.x, 0.0, 1.0));\n}\n\nstruct QuadOut {\n  @builtin(position) clip: vec4f,\n  @location(0) uv: vec2f,\n  @location(1) @interpolate(flat) color: vec4f,\n  @location(2) @interpolate(flat) life: vec4f,\n};\n\n@vertex fn vs(v: DecalVertex) -> QuadOut {\n  let f = decal_frame(v.m0, v.m1, v.m2);\n  let world = f.origin + f.ax * v.position.x + f.ay * v.position.y + f.normal * decal.shape.z;\n  var o: QuadOut;\n  o.clip = camera.view_proj * vec4f(world, 1.0);\n  o.uv = v.uv_rect.xy + vec2f(v.position.x + 0.5, 0.5 - v.position.y) * v.uv_rect.zw;\n  o.color = v.color;\n  o.life = v.life;\n  return o;\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs(in: QuadOut) -> FragOut {\n  let c = textureSample(decal_tex, decal_sampler, in.uv) * in.color;\n  return decal_out(c, c.a * decal_age_fade(in.life));\n}\n";

## Water
class Water implements Drawable {
    level: number;
    readonly origin: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    readonly shallowColor: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    readonly deepColor: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    depthFade: number;
    fresnel: number;
    roughness: number;
    waves: WaterWave[];
    foam: WaterFoam | null;
    displace: number;
    opacity: number;
    depthTarget: SceneTarget | null;
    readsDepth: boolean;
    time: number;
    readonly mesh: Mesh;
    refraction: number;
    reflectionSteps: number;
    reflectionReach: number;
    readonly sunDirection: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    readonly sunColor: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    readonly skyColor: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    readonly coreDrawable: WaterOnCore | null;
    constructor(renderer: Renderer | RenderCore, opts?: WaterOptions);
    update(dt: number): void;
    prepare(encoder: GPUCommandEncoder, frame?: Frame): void;
    draw(pass: GPURenderPassEncoder, frame?: Frame): void;
    afterOpaque(_encoder: GPUCommandEncoder, view: ViewInfo): void;
    destroy(): void;
}

## WaterFoam  (type-only)
interface WaterFoam {
    width: number;
    color: ArrayLike<number>;
}

## WaterOnCore
class WaterOnCore implements CoreDrawable {
    readonly core: RenderCore;
    readonly label = "water";
    readonly pass = "transparent";
    readonly order = -1;
    readonly readsDepth = true;
    readonly readsColor: boolean;
    version: number;
    active: boolean;
    static readonly CALLS = 1;
    constructor(core: RenderCore, water: Water, params: GPUBuffer, opts: WaterOnCoreOptions);
    prepare(encoder: GPUCommandEncoder): void;
    record(enc: CoreDrawableEncoder, ctx: CoreDrawContext): number;
    destroy(): void;
}

interface WaterOnCoreOptions {
    readsColor: boolean;
}

## WaterOptions  (type-only)
interface WaterOptions {
    size?: number | [number, number];
    segments?: number | [number, number];
    level?: number;
    origin?: ArrayLike<number>;
    shallowColor?: ArrayLike<number>;
    deepColor?: ArrayLike<number>;
    depthFade?: number;
    fresnel?: number;
    roughness?: number;
    waves?: WaterWave[];
    foam?: Partial<WaterFoam> | null;
    displace?: number;
    opacity?: number;
    depthTarget?: SceneTarget;
    readsDepth?: boolean;
    refraction?: number;
    reflectionSteps?: number;
    reflectionReach?: number;
    sunDirection?: ArrayLike<number>;
    sunColor?: ArrayLike<number>;
    skyColor?: ArrayLike<number>;
}

}

## Weather
class Weather implements CoreDrawable {
    readonly label = "weather";
    readonly pass: string;
    readonly order = 10;
    readonly encoding = "bundle";
    version: number;
    active: boolean;
    readonly wind: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    intensity: number;
    density: number;
    occlusionHeight: number;
    light: number;
    nearFade: number;
    anchor: [number, number, number] | null;
    instances: number;
    time: number;
    constructor(core: RenderCore, opts?: WeatherOptions);
    configure(config: WeatherConfig): void;
    get layerCount(): number;
    setOcclusionMap(map: WeatherOcclusionMap | null): void;
    update(dt: number): void;
    prepare(): void;
    record(enc: CoreDrawableEncoder, ctx: CoreDrawContext): number;
    destroy(): void;
}
